The '''Naboo Royal Navy''' was an organization within the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Navy/Legends|navy]] operated from a [[Naboo Royal Navy base|base]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]]. The forces within the navy included [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] [[Boat/Legends|vessels]], [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and later [[NB-1 Royal Bomber]]s. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], the Royal Navy unsuccessfully attacked the invading [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]], which had [[Invasion of Spinnaker|taken over]] a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|Naboo village]]. The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] responded to further attacks with [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]] and later used [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]] to destroy the navy's base.

==Description==
The Naboo Royal Navy was part of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], an organization that served the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Royal House of Naboo/Legends|Royal House of Naboo]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Navy/Legends|navy]] operated from a [[Naboo Royal Navy base|base]] that lay on a [[Water/Legends|river]] southwest of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Spinnaker/Legends|Spinnaker]] and west of a [[Unidentified Naboo village (OOM-9)|village]]. The base contained multiple [[Barracks/Legends|troop centers]] and a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]], which could be used to train [[Security Guard/Legends|Royal troopers]],<ref name="GB" /> [[Tuskcat Trooper]]s,<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> and [[Royal crusader]]s, along with a [[Heavy Weapons Factory]] and a [[Mech/Legends|mech]] [[Factory/Legends|factory]], both of which could produce military vehicles.<ref name="GB" />

The base also held a [[Shipyard (water)|shipyard]] on the river, which could be used to manufacture military-capable [[Boat/Legends|boats]] such as [[Scout (Royal Naboo)|Light Scouts]]. The base was later expanded to include an [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] that could assemble [[NB-1 Royal Bomber]]s. It was additionally protected by [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] and [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]]. A group of [[PKN-49 worker droid]]s tended to the base, gathering natural resources and constructing buildings. Additional vehicles used by the navy included [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]] and [[Naboo energy catapult]]s.<ref name="GB" /> The [[Spinnaker Navy]] was associated with the Naboo Royal Navy, directly serving Spinnaker with vessels operating on its coastline.<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

==History==
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], Spinnaker was targeted by the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Shortly before the [[invasion of Spinnaker]] began, the [[Labor droid/Legends|worker droids]] expanded the base's defenses by constructing an additional [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] generator near the entrance and an airbase on the other side of the river. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] captured and occupied the village near Spinnaker and the Naboo Royal Navy's base. In response, the Naboo Royal Navy sent an [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacking]] force of Royal crusaders, three [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]], three Naboo energy catapults,<ref name="GB" /> and three [[Tusk cat|Tuckcat]] [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] to the village.<ref name="CC" /> The [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] repelled the attack and subsequently focused on fortifying their new base and expanding their territory while the Royal Navy continued to send boats, [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]], and troopers to attack. OOM-9 sent a group of three labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to build multiple turrets in the space between the village and the Navy's base.<ref name="Prima" />

[[File:Naboo_Royal_Navy_destroyed.png|thumb|right|300px|The Navy's base came under attack by the Trade Federation.]]
The labor droids began gathering the area's [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], a highly valuable natural resource, which the Royal Navy fought to reclaim. The droids sent six [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid Starfighters]] to protect the workers from the Navy's forces. When OOM-9 was ready to destroy the Navy, he ordered ten Droid Starfighters to clear out their boats on the river and sent in [[Energy pummel/Legends|energy pummels]] to destroy the base's fortress and turrets, losing at least one of the pummels in the process. With those defenses eliminated, the Trade Federation used its fighters to destroy the Navy's remaining forces while the pummels destroyed every building. When attacking Spinnaker itself, the boats of the Spinnaker Navy were also destroyed.<ref name="Prima" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Royal Navy was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;before appearing in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The Navy appears as an opposing faction to the player in "Spinnaker's Spoils," the third level of the Trade Federation campaign. The player is not required to defeat the Navy in order to complete the level,<ref name="GB" /> but the strategy guide recommends doing so.<ref name="Prima" />

The guide describes the Navy as having [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turrets]], more than one fortress, and a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]],<ref name="Prima" /> but none of these are present in the game. The Naboo Royal Navy creating units to attack the player, only stopping once they are defeated. In the game's hard and moderate difficulty modes, the Naboo Royal Navy's CPU immediately begins building an additional shield generator and the airbase, whereas in easy mode, the base begins with the additional shield generator already in place. In all versions, the Navy's PKN-49 worker droids may construct additional buildings.<ref name="GB" /> This article follows the hard difficulty mode's version of events.
